asof_macros.segment_features_asof: CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO segment_features_asof(ts) AS TABLE SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<root>/fundamentals_notes/segment_features.parquet') WHERE available_at < CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMPTZ) QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cik, period ORDER BY available_at DESC, adsh DESC) = 1

asof_usage: latest annual features per issuer visible at decision session d: SELECT * FROM segment_features_asof(lake_cutoff(d)) WHERE is_annual AND period >= d - INTERVAL 548 DAY QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY cik ORDER BY period DESC) = 1
asof_note: available_at is TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE (UTC); with the catalog's TimeZone='UTC' it compares to a naive UTC ts. Identical to the stagelake vintage <view>_as_of macro with keys (cik, period) and order (available_at, adsh).
